name: Intercom
description: Customer communications platform for sales, marketing, and support used by growing SaaS companies.
raw_notes: Strong CX ecosystem player; frequent product launches in AI inbox / Fin AI agent. Useful as competitor-adjacent signal and market proof, but also a buyer of research automation for internal support at scale.

signals.description: Continued Fin AI agent expansion and AI inbox features increasing complexity of support workflows
Ongoing hiring for AI and customer support / success roles across US and Europe
Public positioning around AI customer service at scale for B2B SaaS

name: Notion
description: All-in-one workspace for notes, docs, and project management used heavily by B2B teams.
raw_notes: Rapid user growth and enterprise push; support volume and knowledge fragmentation are classic pain points as product surface area expands.

signals.description: Enterprise and AI features expanding seat count and support complexity
Customer experience and support-adjacent roles posted as product breadth grows
Notion AI and new database/workflow features increase help-center research load

name: Linear
description: Issue tracking and project management software purpose-built for high-performance product teams.
raw_notes: Fast-growing product-led SaaS; support quality is brand-critical. Strong ICP fit for support research automation as customer base moves upmarket.

signals.description: Well-capitalized growth stage with continued product investment (historical Series C and ongoing expansion)
Hiring across product and customer-facing teams as customer count scales
Rapid adoption among startups and scale-ups driving higher ticket complexity

name: Vercel
description: Frontend cloud platform for deploying and scaling modern web applications.
raw_notes: Enterprise push + developer community scale = complex support research across docs, billing, and infra incidents.

signals.description: Enterprise plans and compliance features expanding account complexity
Continued executive and go-to-market leadership buildup around enterprise motion
Support / success / solutions roles tied to enterprise onboarding

name: Loom
description: Async video messaging platform widely used by SaaS GTM and support teams (Atlassian).
raw_notes: Post-acquisition integration and enterprise distribution via Atlassian can create support research bottlenecks and tooling consolidation decisions.

signals.description: Integration into Atlassian ecosystem prompting workflow and support-tool consolidation
Enterprise packaging and admin controls expanding seat and ticket volume
Customer-facing roles to support broader Atlassian-led distribution

name: Calendly
description: Scheduling automation platform for sales, success, and recruiting teams.
raw_notes: Mature PLG SaaS with enterprise motion; support research across integrations and billing is a recurring ops theme.

signals.description: Customer support and success hiring to sustain enterprise growth
Workflow and routing product updates increasing configuration-related tickets
Continued multi-product expansion across scheduling use cases

name: Retool
description: Platform to build internal tools quickly for operations and engineering teams.
raw_notes: Upselling into enterprise accounts; support agents need deep product + customer context research across complex deployments.

signals.description: Significant late-stage funding history enabling GTM and support scale-up
Hiring for support, solutions, and customer engineers around enterprise deals
Enterprise security/admin features and larger deployments

name: Airtable
description: Low-code platform to build apps and workflows on top of flexible data.
raw_notes: Platform breadth creates high research load for support; enterprise customers expect faster, consistent answers.

signals.description: Periodic GTM and product leadership changes as company focuses on AI and enterprise
AI and interface features expanding support surface area
Complex multi-base / interface setups increase agent research time per ticket

name: PostHog
description: Open-source product analytics and feature-flag platform for engineering-led teams.
raw_notes: Fast hiring, product velocity, and community-led growth — classic moment where support research automation pays off.

signals.description: Growth funding enabling rapid hiring and product expansion
Aggressive hiring including customer success / support-adjacent roles
Public engineering blog posts discussing scale, supportability, and product complexity

name: Amplitude
description: Digital analytics platform helping product teams understand user behavior.
raw_notes: Public company with enterprise customers; support research across complex instrumentation use cases is a fit, though buying motion may be slower.

signals.description: Competitive pressure in product analytics increasing need for efficient CX ops
Selective hiring in customer-facing organizations

name: Plain.com
description: Modern B2B customer support platform built for technical support teams.
raw_notes: Support-native product company; strong ICP for research automation as they scale customers who themselves need better support tooling. Also competitor-adjacent.

signals.description: Early growth capital and market attention in modern support tooling
Small-team hiring for GTM and support as customer base expands
Public content focused on B2B support quality and operational bottlenecks

name: Help Scout
description: Customer support platform for growing businesses with shared inbox and knowledge base.
raw_notes: Support platform vendor — high problem relevance; may buy research automation for their own CX or partner around it. Moderate timing vs faster-scaling product-led peers.

signals.description: AI and workflow features in helpdesk product line
Steady SMB/mid-market customer growth
